note: Ozark National Scenic Riverways campground on the Jacks Fork near Alley Spring and its red mill, a short walk from a swimming area on the river; paved roads and spurs, ranger campfire programs in summer. --Claude
summary: Rates confirmed (10/30; electric +$10); 164 sites, 28 electric 50A with water in Loop 600, no sewer, dump at entrance; RV spurs to 64 ft; bookable on rec.gov year-round, 14-night max. Not waterfront kept; northern loops flagged as a possible riverview.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): kept. Loop 600 (electric, sites at ~37.1450-37.1462,-91.4494..-91.4485) and loops 400/800/900 sit ~150 m south of the Jacks Fork behind the main campground road. The northern loops (RIDB gives no site coordinates; by elimination Loops 100/200/300/500) run along the south bank: their loop road is ~10-20 m from the water and the spurs inside it ~30-50 m, through open woods on leaf-off imagery. The loop road between pads and river caps them at riverview, and with no photo showing a view through the summer canopy I leave not waterfront. Possible riverview - AWH call. The channel is ~16-24 m of water beside a wide gravel bar.
Phone: entry has none; rec.gov gives 573-323-4236 (campground operations, weekdays) and (573) 561-0580. apply.py does not write phone.
Website is the rec.gov page - fine.
Pin 37.1472,-91.4497 is on the campground road between the northern and southern loops - fine.
